read.thesis: Telecom quarter with steady mobile service growth of 6.3% and EBITDA up 8.9% to 102bn pesos, but capex is falling and net debt cut to 1.21x; no supply-side capacity signal and no numeric guidance given.

triggers.label: Mobile service revenue +6.3% YoY
triggers.quote: Mobile service revenue increased 6.3% year-on-year, maintaining the pace observed in the prior quarter.

triggers.label: 9M capex 75.9bn vs 84.9bn
triggers.quote: In the nine months to September our capital expenditures totaled 76 billion pesos.

triggers.label: Net debt/EBITDAaL 1.52x → 1.21x
triggers.quote: It was equivalent to 1.21x net debt to EBITDAal, down from 1.52x at the end of 2025.

red_flags.label: Comprehensive financing cost +75% on FX loss
red_flags.quote: our comprehensive financing cost increased 75% as a result of foreign exchange losses of 3.6 billion pesos in the period
